caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, monochromatic illustration of a lion’s head executed in shades of gray and black, with subtle variations for shading and texture. The lion head is shown from the front, displaying both ears, wide eyes, a broad nose, pronounced cheekbones, and a slightly open mouth revealing part of the upper teeth. The face is surrounded by a thick, stylized mane that frames the head symmetrically, with curved lines representing the fur. The entire composition is centered on a plain, light background. No additional objects or elements are present in the image. There is a signature toward the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Muzzle of a Lion (one of pair)
